audit_items.proof_trace: Two symmetric mutual-exclusion guards enforce the invariant: `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) asserts `!self.debts.contains(CoinType)` before registering a collateral entry, and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) asserts `!self.ctokens.is_supporting_collateral<MarketType, CoinType>()` on the first-borrow path. `is_supporting_collateral` is cleared atomically when all ctokens are withdrawn (`ctoken_table::split_ctoken` L96 removes the `ctoken_values` entry when balance reaches zero), so a full-withdraw followed by a borrow is permitted and leaves collateral balance at zero — no overlap. Grep confirmed both functions are called exclusively via `market::handle_mint` and `market::handle_borrow`; liquidation handlers only reduce both sides and cannot introduce new collateral+debt overlap.
